tone: Use concise, neutral Turkish with consistent direct software phrasing.
capitalization: Use sentence case and Turkish dotted and dotless I rules correctly.
button_labels: Use short conventional action labels and omit final periods.
ui_roles: Keep labels concise, buttons action-oriented, tooltips explanatory, and warnings or errors as natural complete sentences.
technical_terms: Use established Turkish software terms and preserve glossary tokens.
contextual_terminology: Resolve ambiguous terms from the feature, stable ID, surface type, and neighboring strings; use natural Turkish structure instead of source-order calques.
punctuation: Apply Turkish punctuation conventions without changing accelerators or syntax.
units: Use metric conventions, comma decimals where applicable, and conventional spacing.
natural_language: Use idiomatic Turkish suffixing and word order rather than English calques.
